source_architecture_summary: Two first-person passages examine inheritance through attachment to place, practical knowledge, and ambivalent relationships with what an earlier generation leaves behind.
feasibility_notes: Both blueprints replace the source's mothers, migration, water, art, and city motifs. Blueprint A pairs an orchard notebook with radio-repair tools; Blueprint B pairs a bowling alley archive with a volunteer weather station.

blueprints.blueprint_focus: Two narrators receive incomplete forms of practical knowledge: an orchard notebook whose dates depend on observation and a set of radio tools whose uses survive among former customers.
blueprints.overall_reading_skill_family: Paired memoir, inheritance, tacit knowledge, and qualified belonging
blueprints.rhetorical_or_narrative_arc: Passage A moves from literal obedience to situated reading; Passage B moves from orderly disposal to community reconstruction; comparison reveals inheritance as active interpretation
blueprints.distinctness_notes: Uses practical craft knowledge and objects, with no migration or artistic inheritance.

blueprints.blueprint_focus: Two narrators preserve community records whose value lies in ordinary participation rather than exceptional achievement: bowling score sheets and a volunteer weather log.
blueprints.overall_reading_skill_family: Paired memoir, record keeping, place, community memory, and ambivalence
blueprints.rhetorical_or_narrative_arc: Passage A rediscovers social life in disposable score sheets; Passage B questions and then accepts an imperfect local weather record; synthesis distinguishes factual precision from communal meaning
blueprints.distinctness_notes: Uses communal records rather than inherited technical practice.
